title: Pegasus Spyware Probe, hearing of 29 April 2025
inspection: Hearing narrative: petitioners requested report disclosure; Union security objection; judicial suggestions for affected individuals. Original 2025 signed order not obtained.
excerpt: Individuals could approach the Court to find out if the spyware was found in their devices.
note: The report describes continuing disagreement over release of the sealed technical report. Petitioners sought redacted material; the Solicitor General opposed disclosure on security grounds. The bench discussed giving device-specific answers to individuals. This is hearing reporting, not a final merits ruling, and does not identify the Indian operator or procurement route. Searches to 14 October 2026 did not yield a later original disposition; that is a search gap, not proof the case remained unchanged.
